provenance.authorship: New hand-authored fictional conversations; not generated from long_data.py templates. Identical intake questions deliberately check project isolation.
provenance.cohort: 36 queries, 42 fictional conversations, 6 domains, English and Chinese
provenance.frozen_before: first candidate evaluation on these cases
limits: Small synthetic stress set authored by the same assistant team, not a population sample or independent human annotation.
Short conversations and known evidence labels do not establish large-archive or real-user generalization.
Source-evidence retrieval only; no generated-answer quality is inferred.
provenance.reuse_policy: After first scoring this is regression data. Do not tune on its outcomes and call the rerun heldout.
provenance.selection: all cases; no answer-based or post-result filtering

model.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling followed by L2 normalization

methodology: Evidence retrieval only. Both modes have identical 8000-character caps, exact cl100k_base token caps, top-five page limits and source-preserving assembly. Semantic changes rankings and may lose lexical evidence; report every gain and loss. Labels stay evaluator-side and never enter index/ranking/packing. Report budget, source-span, project-scope, metadata, source-stability and repeated-output invariants. Existing public/synthetic/authored sets are regression data; Hotpot128 is a bounded scoped-distractor multi-hop corpus, not full-Wikipedia or conversational-memory generalization. Model pretraining overlap is unknown. One model, six authored domains and one external corpus cannot establish universal semantic memory or final-answer accuracy. A worse or slower semantic candidate is retained and documented, not tuned on this cohort or silently dropped.

model.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling followed by L2 normalization
